verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents programmatic domain registration in a dedicated register-a-domain guide. The guide includes script-friendly safeguards: availability and pricing checks, a dryRun pre-flight, Idempotency-Key retries, and a sandbox key that runs every operation with fake credit, so registration fits cleanly into a deploy script. Nameserver control is only implied, through NS record CRUD and the Cloudflare nameserver-repoint flow, and contact handling during registration is never documented. missing for 10: documented contact/registrant data calls in the registration flow, an explicit set/update-nameservers endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
